entries.reason: Keep CommonJS queue ordering explicit on an ESM repository.
entries.reasonZh: 明确保留 CommonJS 的任务队列顺序。

entries.reason: Split build topics into Webpack, Grunt and the two handmade bundlers.
entries.reasonZh: 构建专题拆分到 Webpack、Grunt 与两种手写打包器。

entries.reason: Keep declarative copy/clean tasks with an ISC license.
entries.reasonZh: 保留声明式复制与清理任务及 ISC 许可。

entries.reason: Keep every distinct Webpack topic on Webpack 5; use asset modules and current dev-server APIs.
entries.reasonZh: 所有不同 Webpack 专题保留，更新资源模块与开发服务器 API。

entries.reason: Preserve the procedural parse/graph/emit pipeline; fix traversal and cache.
entries.reasonZh: 保留过程式解析、依赖图、输出流程，修复遍历与缓存。

entries.reason: Preserve parser/compiler separation with recursive dependency resolution.
entries.reasonZh: 保留解析器与编译器分层，修复递归依赖解析。

entries.reason: Modern processAssets hook emits a file inventory.
entries.reasonZh: 用 processAssets 生命周期生成文件清单。

entries.reason: Unfinished hooks draft becomes the plugin lifecycle explanation.
entries.reasonZh: 未完成的 hooks 草稿并入插件生命周期说明。

entries.reason: Keep variables, mixins, guards and escaped values; preserve GPL-2.0.
entries.reasonZh: 保留变量、混入、条件与转义知识及 GPL-2.0。

entries.reason: Compile and precompile an escaped template from one input.
entries.reasonZh: 保留模板编译及预编译，明确输入转义边界。

entries.reason: Extract typed actions/reducers; retire duplicated CRA machinery.
entries.reasonZh: 提取类型化 actions/reducers，退役重复 CRA 底座。

entries.reason: Keep task sequencing; delegate compilation to supported TypeScript.
entries.reasonZh: 保留任务编排，用 TypeScript 原生编译器构建。

entries.reason: Keep typed class props and compare type checking with transpilation.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 class 组件类型，区分类型检查与转译。

entries.reason: Hello wrapper merges into a single Card/Button library with three packaging paths.
entries.reasonZh: Hello 外壳合入 Card/Button 小型组件库与三种打包对照。

entries.reason: Retain Card and its CSS; retire CRA scaffold.
entries.reasonZh: 提取 Card 与 CSS，退役 CRA 外壳。

entries.reason: Retain Button; consolidate its Storybook and Webpack scaffolds.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Button，合并 Storybook 与 Webpack 底座。

entries.reason: Remove duplicate library/CRA and generated Storybook examples.
entries.reasonZh: 移除重复组件库、CRA 及自动生成的 Storybook 示例。
